explanation.summary: High harmful-algal-bloom screening signal for Demo Lake community.

en.title: Water watch: high concern
en.message: A high harmful-algal-bloom screening signal was detected for Demo Lake community. Do not swim, drink untreated water, or harvest food from the affected water.
en.action: Keep people and animals away and contact the local health or water authority for confirmation.

sw.title: Uangalizi wa maji: hatari kubwa
sw.message: Ishara kubwa ya mwani hatari imegunduliwa katika Demo Lake community. Usiogelee, usinywe maji yasiyotibiwa, wala usivune chakula kutoka kwenye maji yaliyoathirika.
sw.action: Waweke watu na wanyama mbali na maji hayo na wasiliana na mamlaka ya afya au maji kwa uthibitisho.
